name: STRANGER SYNTH
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A performance synth: 80s analogue poly sounds, arps, a low split, tape and VHS effects
description: A performance synth in the spirit of 80s analogue film scores: classic poly and mono sounds, an arpeggiator, a low split the melody follows, chords with sidechain, tape and VHS performance effects. Work in progress, based on OFFWORLD.
credits: Based on OFFWORLD (swtdr34mz). Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
